Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this lopsided series where New Zealand Women stamped their authority but India Women showed in this match that they have a lot of fight to bring in the upcoming mega event. We are now fast approaching the ICC Women's World Cup 2022 but before that, all the teams will be involved in a few warm-up games from 27th February 2022. We look forward to your company for future matches. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Sophie Devine, the captain of New Zealand Women, expresses her disappointment and says that they were 10-15 runs short and for the first time in the series, they didn't have enough wickets going into the death overs. Feels that they need to train more as it's more about focus and mindset and not about skills. Mentions that they are in a really good space before the World Cup and every player in the squad has stepped up. Admits that there is pressure playing at home but there are advantages as well. Praises Amelia Kerr for an outstanding series.

Mithali Raj, the captain of India Women, says that to have the whole strength and squad playing the last game helped and it's a good sign ahead of the World Cup. Tells that before the big event it's important to have the right preparation which they didn't get back home due to the rising Omicron cases. Shares that the wicket seemed batting-friendly but they bowled well. Mentions that they understood the importance of bowling well in the middle overs. States that they need to work more on the fielding department as the batting group has done well and the bowling group turned up well in this match. Adds that it's good to see some bright talent in the squad who will be the future stars of Indian cricket.

Amelia Kerr is the unanimous choice for the Player of the Series award! She scored 353 runs in the series at an average of 117.7, striking at 97.5. Amelia Kerr also picked up 7 wickets along with grabbing 9 catches. She comes up for a chat... says that she loved it here in Queenstown and everyone performed well. Tells that India are a quality side and it's about taking each game as it comes. Adds that they need to maintain the same process heading into the World Cup. Hopes to keep it going and stay competitive. Mentions that she enjoys her dual role and it's not a burden. Feels that they are heading in the right direction as a group but also admits that they need to do better as a fielding group.

Smriti Mandhana is chosen for the Player of the Match award! The Indian opener says that their bowlers did a fantastic job and the wicket was good to bat and all the batting unit contributed. Adds that she took some time to get in and is happy to find some rhythm before the World Cup. Feels that this series was a big advantage for the whole team. Tells that they had a few close games and all the girls are feeling confident. She wants to take the momentum of this last win into the World Cup.
Presentation time...

With the series already in the pocket, New Zealand Women perhaps took the foot off the pedal a little bit. Their batting didn't have the same kind of fire while with the ball, they were not consistent. The performance in the field was dismal too as they dropped plenty of catches. The hosts will take the series 4-1 but have a few loopholes to fix before the upcoming World Cup.

The bowling from India Women was neat, especially from their spin trio of Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Deepti Sharma and Sneh Rana. They bowled with great accuracy, created good pressure and hunted down six wickets among themselves. New Zealand Women looked good at one stage to reach 300 but got restricted to only 251 and India Women overhauled the target with four overs to spare. Smriti Mandhana showed her class with the bat and stroked a fabulous fifty and she was joined by Harmanpreet Kaur and Mithali Raj who also played vital knocks. The three big names of India Women have struck form at the right time and they will be feeling very confident ahead of the mega event.

A comfortable win for India Women and they have successfully avoided the ignominy of a series whitewash. This was the kind of match that the touring team will feel satisfied with. They fielded their best XI, in the words of Mithali Raj, and ticked most of the necessary boxes that were bothering them in the last four games.
Here it is... Too full in length, around off, Mithali Raj walks down the track and drills her drive through covers for the winning run. India Women win by 6 wickets!
A yorker around middle, Mithali digs it out to mid-wicket.
Fuller and around off, it's swept fine down the leg side for a brace. Scores are level!
FOUR! Fifty for Mithali Raj, she continues with her good form. Frances Mackay drops it short and on middle, Mithali Raj stands back inside the crease and pulls it to the deep square leg fence.
FOUR! Hammered down the ground! Flighted and full, landing around off, Mithali Raj wears her skates and smashes it past the bowler for a boundary. 7 needed more.
Loopy and full around middle, Mithali Raj top-edges her attempted sweep shot wide of short fine leg. They take two.
Width on offer outside off, Mithali Raj slaps it aerially through cover-point for a single. 13 needed more.
Wide! Angling down the leg side, on the shorter side, Mithali Raj swings her bat at it and misses.
Rowe goes short around off, Ghosh hooks it to deep square leg for a single.
Off pace, short and around off, Raj hangs on the back foot and plays it late to third man for another run in that region.
Pitches it up and outside off, Mithali drives but finds the fielder inside the ring at cover-point.
Delivers it on a length, around off and angling in, the batter strokes it from the crease through cover-point for a run.
On a length and close to off, Mithali Raj plays late and dabs it to third man for a single.
Slower through the air, full and around off, Raj drives it to sweeper cover for a single. 19 needed more off 6 overs.
Loopy and full around off, Ghosh sweeps it behind square leg for a single.
Full and on off, flicked to mid-wicket.
Full and flighted on off, Mithali Raj scuffs her attempted heave off the inner edge to mid on. It doesn't carry to the fielder and they cross for a run.
Walks down the track and forces a full ball back to the bowler. Frances Mackay sticks her right hand out and stops the ball.
Arm ball around off, defended to the off side.
Width there outside off, Richa Ghosh throws her bat at it and gets an under-edge. It goes on one bounce to the keeper.
Play and a miss! Short in length and wide outside off, Ghosh swishes and misses.
FOUR! What a shot! Short in length and around off, Ghosh rides the bounce and pulls it emphatically in the gap at deep square leg for a boundary.
Fuller in length, around off, Richa defends it watchfully towards mid off.
Back of a length, around middle, Raj works it behind square leg for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kaur departs. Fuller delivery, on the slower side around off, Harmanpreet Kaur tries to heave it over the leg side but gets a big top edge. The ball flies towards square leg where Amy Satterthwaite takes the skier safely and is looking relieved. End of a fantastic knock from Kaur. 27 needed more off 47 balls and Richa Ghosh joins Mithali in the middle.
Commentary.Howout: c Amy Satterthwaite b Hannah Rowe

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! A low full toss down the leg side, Harmanpreet Kaur tries to get some bat behind it but misses.
Mix-up but no harm done! A cutter around off, Mithali Raj tries to defend but gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket. Harmanpreet Kaur wants a run but is sent back. 28 needed more off 48 balls.
Slower one, on a length and around off, Harmanpreet Kaur goes down and across as she pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and around off, it's drilled down the ground to long off for a couple of runs.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Short in length, around off and angling in, Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it off her front foot to deep mid-wicket where Hannah Rowe fails to catch it. It bursts through her hands and goes behind to meet the fence.
Gentle delivery, on a length and wide outside off, Kaur pushes at it and misses.
Full in length and wide outside off, Mithali Raj reaches out for it and slices it wide of backward point for a single.
Bouncer around off, Kaur leaves it alone. It's not called a wide.
FOUR! Bang! That's stylish from Harmanpreet Kaur.​ Sophie Devine goes short and around off, Kaur walks forward and pulls it disdainfully off her front foot for a boundary at mid-wicket.
Slower one, full and outside off, Mithali Raj runs it down to third man and rotates the strike. 40 needed more off 56 balls.
Full toss around off, Mithali pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Wide for height! A bumper goes well over the head of the batter.
Fuller and on off, Mithali Raj defends it by getting forward.
A touch short and outside off, Raj plays it from the back foot to the off side. Not in the gap.
Quicker and fuller on middle, Mithali Raj sweeps it behind square leg and keeps strike with a single.
Forces a full ball down to mid on. Dot.
Shortish and outside off, Mithali Raj plays late and guides it wide of short third man for a brace.
FOUR! Quality shot! Full and flighted outside off, Mithali Raj steps back to make room and lofts it cleanly over extra cover for a boundary.
Full and around off, Harmanpreet Kaur heaves it over mid-wicket and it goes on one bounce to the fielder in the deep. They cross. The 50-run stand comes up!
Short and outside off, Mithali Raj pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! That brings up the 200 for India Women and fifty for Harmanpreet Kaur! Much-needed half-century for her! Another short ball, around middle, Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Shorter ball, on middle, Mithali Raj pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller now, outside off. Mithali Raj pushes it towards covers.
Back of a length, outside off. Mithali Raj leans back, opens the face of her bat, and tries to upper-cut this but misses.
Fraction short, on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it gently towards square leg for a single.
On a length, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it out.
Fuller again, on middle. Mithali Raj steps down and pushes it towards mid off. 57 runs needed off 72 balls now.
Outside off, fuller length, Mithali Raj taps it towards point.
Turning back in with some extra bounce, Mithali Raj defends it by taking her bottom hand off the handle.
Nice loop on this one, full and on off, Kaur sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it to sweeper cover for one.
Fuller and on off, swept to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another shorter one, around middle. Mithali Raj ducks underneath it.
Shorter ball, outside off. Mithali Raj swings her bat at it, but misses.
Pitches it up, around middle and leg. Harmanpreet Kaur clips it towards deep square leg for another single.
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Harmanpreet Kaur tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Slower full toss, on middle. Mithali Raj nudges it towards square leg. Single taken!
Can Sophie Devine provide a breakthrough?
A fuller ball, on the pads. Harmanpreet Kaur works it away towards square leg for a single.
Tad fuller, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur punches it past cover for a single. 63 needed off 84 balls.
Shorter, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur cuts it towards point.
Loopy ball, fuller, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to sweep this, but misses.
Shorter ball, now, spinning away, outside off. Mithali Raj gets across and works it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Lovely placement! A fuller ball, outside off. Mithali Raj gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Loopy ball, outside off. Mithali Raj leaves it alone.
Back of  a length, outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur cuts but finds the point fielder. 69 needed off 15 overs.
Slower one, full and angling in around off, Harmanpreet Kaur picks it late and defends it to the off side.
Short this time, wide outside off, Raj plays late and runs it down to third man for a run.
On a length and outside off, Mithali Raj stays back and taps it down to backward point.
Wide! Full and drifting down the leg side, Mithali Raj tries to flick but misses.
Digs it in short, around middle, Kaur stands back and pulls it to fine leg for a run.
Short in length and wide outside off, Mithali Raj slaps it to deep backward point for a single.
Loopy and around off, Harmanpreet Kaur uses her feet and then defends it down on the surface. 73 needed off 96 balls.
Flatter arm ball on off, Kaur taps it down on the off side and looks for a run. She is sent back.
Flatter and outside off, stroked to deep cover for a run.
A touch short and around off, Mithali Raj plays very late and guides it wide of the keeper and short third man for a couple of runs.
Arm ball around off, Raj tries to defend but gets an inside edge towards square leg.
FOUR! Wonderful shot! Full and floated around off, Mithali skips down the track and creams her drive through the gap at extra cover for a boundary.
Width outside off, Mithali Raj reaches out and dabs it towards third man for a single. 80 needed off 102 balls.
Fuller in length around off, Mithali Raj plays a lovely straight drive but the bowler makes the stop.
Wide! Bouncer but down the leg side, Raj leaves it alone.
On a length around middle, Kaur drops it with gentle hands towards square leg for one.
A gentle outswinger, around off, Harmanpreet Kaur pushes inside the line and misses.
Fuller and on middle, Mithali Raj chips her flick shot over mid-wicket for a single.
Lands it on a length and outside off, Mithali pushes it with an angled bat to point. Kaur shows interest in a run but then returns as the fielder misses her shy at the bowler's end.

DRINKS! Although India Women have lost Smriti Mandhana, they are still cruising along nicely. Harmanpreet Kaur has found some form in the last game and is scoring at a brisk rate. New Zealand Women have been a little sloppy in the field, and have failed to grab wickets at regular intervals. They have kept the batters quiet in the last few overs, but India Women are still on top. They need 84 runs off 108 balls. Also, Hannah Rowe comes back into the attack.
Loopy and full around off, Mithali Raj jumps down the track and crunches her drive towards wide mid off. Amy Satterthwaite dives across to her left to stop the ball and they cross for a single.
Fullish and outside off, Mithali Raj drives but finds the fielder at cover-point.
Stays back to this delivery and taps it down to point.
Full toss on off, Harmanpreet Kaur punches it from the back foot to covers for a run.
Flatter and outside off, Raj plays late and guides it wide of short third man for one.
Works it away towards square leg for one.
Wide! Skidding down the leg side, Kaur tries flicking but misses.
Advances down the track and brings her bat and pad together in defense.
A googly outside off, left alone.
Turning away from the batter, Raj tries to cut but misses.
Gets on the front foot and defends it to covers.
Full and around off, driven through cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Shot! This will release the pressure created by the dot balls. Full and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur sits down on one knee and nails her sweep shot to the deep square leg fence.
Tosses it up, full again, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur knocks it down to long on for a single.
Loopy ball, very full, outside off. Mithali Raj drives it past cover and rotates the strike!
Make that four dots! Quicker again, on middle and leg. Mithali Raj blocks it out.
Quicker now, flatter and on middle. Mithali Raj nudges it to the fielder at mid on. Three dots in a row now!
Another tossed up ball, full and on middle. Mithali Raj has pushed this away towards mid on.
Loopy ball, outside off. Mithali Raj presses forward and taps it towards covers.
Tosses this one up, full and outside off. Mithali Raj drives it towards cover for a single. She retains the strike!
Short again, outside off. Mithali Raj stays deep in her crease and slashes it past point for a brace. She opens her account with that.
Shorter one, outside off. Mithali Raj hangs back and blocks it out.
Skipper Mithali Raj walks out to the centre.

OUT! CAUGHT! This is the breakthrough New Zealand Women were desperately searching for! Flighted delivery, full and around middle, Smriti Mandhana tries to whip it over the leg side but doesn't get the desired elevation. It flies quickly to Suzie Bates at mid-wicket who takes it safely. End of a fine knock and New Zealand Women have a chance to build some pressure. 99 needed off 130 balls!
Commentary.Howout: c Suzie Bates b Amelia Kerr

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, a shade short and skidding away, Smriti Mandhana plays it from the back foot to backward point.
Full and flighted outside off, Kaur sweeps against the spin to mid-wicket where the fielder fumbles and concedes a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 11 runs off the over!
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Another fuller ball, tossed up, Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps this one from outside off towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary!
FOUR! Crunched! Outside off, fuller ball. Harmanpreet Kaur gets low and sweeps it past mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.

Misjudged the catch! Oh, dear! New Zealand Women cannot afford this! A fuller ball, around middle, Harmanpreet Kaur steps down the pitch and miscues her shot towards long on. Suzie Bates completely loses it in the sun and the chance goes down begging. They take two runs.
Loopy ball, now, full and on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter ball, outside off, pushed to point.
Frances Mackay is back into the attack. 0/18 in her 6 overs so far.

FOUR! Easy pickings! Loopy ball, full, and down the leg side. Smriti Mandhana gets low and sweeps it towards fine leg for a boundary. She moves to 71 and this is now the highest individual score for an Indian on this tour.
Shorter ball, outside off, pushed to point.
Loopy ball, full and outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it back to the bowler, who dives to her right and makes a good stop!
Loopy ball, full and outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur tries to nudge this away on the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads.
Fuller ball, on the pads. Smriti Mandhana tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Amelia Kerr to continue from this end...
Quicker now, firing it on the pads. Harmanpreet Kaur clips it to square leg. Dot to finish the over!
Loopy ball now, full, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur nudges it to mid-wicket. Another dot ball!
Short again, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur hangs back and cuts it towards cover.
Shorter now, outside off. Smriti Mandhana steers it past point for a single.
FOUR! Wonderful shot! Fuller ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana steps down and drives it past cover for a boundary.
Tosses it up, outside off. Smriti Mandhana taps it towards third man for a brace.
Flatter and around leg, Mandhana swivels and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Hangs on the back foot and cuts it to point.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it behind square leg for a run.
Two wides! Down the leg side, Mandhana fails to get any touch and the keeper also fails. They cross.
Helps it away off her pads to square leg for a single.
On middle and leg, Kaur goes down to sweep but fails to connect neatly.
Just short of the fielder! Full and flighted outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur charges down the track and squeezes it out to point.
Fuller and on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single. 9 from the over!
Was there a tickle? Loopy and full, sliding down the leg side, Kaur tries to sweep but seems to have got a bit of tickle there. The keeper fails to hold on though. No signal from the umpire.
Flatter again, outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Flatter and shorter on off, Smriti Mandhana initially tries to use her feet but then stays back to play it down towards point.
On the pads, it's nudged towards fine leg for a run.

SIX! That's dispatched! Full and floated, landing around off, Harmanpreet Kaur shimmies down the track and launches it over long on for a biggie. Smriti Mandhana hugs her partner. Kaur has been out of form and needs a good outing here for her confidence.
Fuller and straighter from Kerr, it's swept behind square leg for a single.
Knocks a full ball down to long off for a single.
Extra bounce again as Amelia Kerr bowls it slower through the air. Around leg, Smriti Mandhana goes on the back foot and pushes it away aerially to the off side.

Stumping appeal, not entertained. Amelia Kerr comes up with a great delivery. Lands it around off and it spins away a shade with some extra bounce, Smriti Mandhana prods forward to defend but it whistles past the outside edge. The keeper takes the bails off and appeals but nothing from the square leg umpire.
Darts it in, full and on middle, Kaur sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Floated and full, around off, defended to the off side.
A touch short and on off, skidding in, Harmanpreet Kaur goes on the back foot and caresses it through covers for a single. India Women are Nelson for 2!
Flighted and on off, Harmanpreet uses her feet and then blocks it back safely.
Extra loop on this delivery, full and around off, Kaur drives it back towards the bowler.
Wide! Spinning down the leg side, Kaur tries to flick but misses.
Flatter and around off, Mandhana walks forward and strokes it past the diving extra cover fielder for a run.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it back.
Tossed up, on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur gets back and helps it behind square leg for a single.
Short again around off, punched from the back foot through point for one.
Fuller and on off, driven down to long off for a single.
Full and on middle, defended back.
Quicker and shorter on off, eased through the gap at cover-point for two.

FOUR! Fifty for Smriti Mandhana and she is back! Full and floated, around middle and leg, Mandhana goes down on one knee and sweeps it sweetly through square leg for a boundary. A lovely knock by her and she will be eyeing a century here!
Short and on off, Smriti punches it from the back foot to covers. Looks for a run but she is sent back.
Turning in, around middle, Harmanpreet Kaur hangs back and pushes it towards cover.
Turning down the leg side, Kaur fails to flick it. Perhaps, it takes some part of her pads and hence it's not a wide.
Very full and on middle, Mandhana forces it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Full and angling down the leg side, it's nudged towards fine leg for a single.
Shorter ball now, outside off, this one keeps low a tad. Smriti Mandhana cuts it towards point. Single taken!
Fuller ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana steps down and knocks it to mid off.
Shorter now, around middle and off. Smriti Mandhana opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for a single.
Fuller now, around middle and off. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Wide! Firing it down the leg side, on a shorter length. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to tuck this away but misses. Wide called!
Quicker one now, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur stays in her crease and looks to slash it, but the ball goes off the inside edge.
Full now, outside off. Smriti Mandhana knocks it towards long off for a single.
Shorter again on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur covers the line and tucks it towards square leg for a single. Harmanpreet Kaur opens her account with that.
Amelia Kerr begins with a shorter ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana hangs back and pushes it towards deep cover for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur has blocked that out off the front foot. Successful over by Fran Jonas!
Shorter ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it past cover off the back foot for a single.
Harmanpreet Kaur walks in next. 163 needed off 194 balls.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally, a catch has been taken by the White Ferns! It's been a frenetic last 3 minutes or so. Two dropped catches followed by this one. Although it's a different batter. Deepti Sharma has no luck. Loopy and full, around off, Deepti Sharma advances down the track to heave it across the line but her bottom hand comes off the handle and she ends up spooning it in the air towards point. Rosemary Mair makes no mistake, although it did bubble up a bit in her hands. The 60-run stand has been broken and New Zealand Women have an opening.
Commentary.Howout: c Rosemary Mair b Fran Jonas

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.

DROPPED! Oh, dear! Another chance goes down! Two in two overs! A full toss, around middle, Smriti Mandhana miscues her shot towards mid on. Amy Satterthwaite is there, she jumps, gets her hands to it, but fails to grab it!
Tosses this one up, around middle, Deepti Sharma taps it towards mid-wicket for a single.

PUT DOWN! A costly miss. Flighted and full around off, Smriti Mandhana presses forward to defend but pushes it early. It goes aerially back to the bowler who goes down low but fails to grab it cleanly.
Tad shorter, around middle and leg. Deepti Sharma nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, Deepti Sharma sweeps this from outside off, towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to her left, dives, and keeps the ball away from the rope. Top save! Two taken!
Fuller on this occasion, outside off. Smriti Mandhana presses forward and taps it towards point for a single.
Shorter one now, around middle and off. Smriti Mandhana shows the full face of her bat and knocks it back to the bowler.
Flatter ball, around middle. Smriti Mandhana hangs back and pushes it to mid on.
Another back of a length, around off. Smriti Mandhana miscues her pull shot towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tad shorter now, around middle. Smriti Mandhana stays in her crease and pushes it back to the bowler.
Another tossed up ball, around middle. Deepti Sharma has swept this away towards deep square leg for a single.
Loopy ball, around middle and leg. Deepti Sharma nudges it away to the fielder at mid-wicket.

Another halt in play as the Indian physio is out to perform the concussion test. Meanwhile, the umpires have decided to take the Drinks break. So far so good from the touring team. They are looking in control at this stage with Smriti Mandhana, in particular, showing good form. Still a long way to go though and New Zealand Women ​​​​​​would hope to pick a few wickets and make a comeback.
Another tossed up delivery, fuller and on middle, Deepti Sharma goes down and looks to sweep, but gets hit on the helmet. The physio is out there to have a check on her!
A loopy ball, full and on middle. Deepti Sharma pushes it towards mid on.
Too full and around off, Deepti Sharma brings out the broom and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single. India Women are going along steadily, 171 needed off 210 balls.
Loopy and around off, fuller in length, Sharma pushes it with an angled bat to point. Looks for a run but it's not on.
Fuller and on off, defended.
Flatter and outside off, played down from the back foot to point.
Full in length and around off, driven down to mid off.
Slider around off, Sharma brings her bat down in time and keeps it out through the inner edge to square leg.
Another short delivery, this time Deepti Sharma fetches it from outside off and pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Digs it in short, around middle, Smriti does well to pull it through square leg for a single.
A touch short and on off, Mandhana punches off the back foot but straight to mid off this time.
Around middle, pushed down the ground but straight to mid on.

FOUR! That's the class of this batter! Fuller and around middle, right in the slot for the batter, Smriti Mandhana gets on the front foot with a straight bat and caresses it past the bowler for a boundary down the ground.
Fuller and close to off, angling away, Mandhana camps back and steers it through the line. Finds point.
Slower through the air, full and on off, Deepti Sharma presses forward in defense.
Fuller and on middle, driven back to the bowler.
A touch short and on off, turning away, Deepti Sharma plays it down to short third man. Smriti Mandhana wants a run but is sent back.
Drags the length short, around off, forced to sweeper cover for a single.
Just in time! A dipping low full toss on off, Sharma sweeps it at the last moment to deep backward square leg for a run. Had she missed, she would have been plumb in front.
Flatter and shorter on off, it's punched from the back foot to covers.

FOUR! Don't bother chasing that! Fuller in length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana leans into the drive and creams it delightfully through the gap at covers for a glorious boundary. 12 from Mair's first over!
Pitches it up and around off, Deepti Sharma strokes it off her front foot and pierces the gap at covers. Fran Jonas chases it down and pulls it back just before the fence. Saves one run for her side.
Short and on middle, Mandhana swivels and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Streaky! Width there outside off, short in length, Smriti Mandhana goes chasing after it as she throws her bat at it. It takes the outside edge and flies over first slip for a boundary.
Another length delivery, close to off and angling away, Smriti stays back and pushes it to cover-point.
Delivers it on a length and outside off, Mandhana punches it from the back foot to point.
Too full in length and on off, it's driven through the gap at covers for a single.
Skidding in from around middle, Sharma moves back and tucks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Eased away! Skidding down the leg side, on the shorter side, Smriti Mandhana turns inside the crease and helps it on its way to the fine leg fence.
A slider around off, skidding in from a fuller length, Smriti defends it back to the bowler.
Slightly short and around off, Smriti Mandhana stays back and strokes it to cover-point.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Length ball, outside off. Deepti Sharma leans and defends it out. At the end of Powerplay 1, India Women are comfortably placed at 53/1.
Wide! Shorter ball again, wide of off, shaping away. Deepti Sharma lets that go through. Wide called!
Shorter ball, outside off. Deepti Sharma leaves it alone.
Leg bye! On a length again, on the pads. Smriti Mandhana looks to tuck this away but misses. The ball deflects off her pads and goes towards fine leg. The batters steal a leg bye!
Good-length delivery, darting it on the pads. Deepti Sharma works it away towards square leg for a single.
On a length, around middle, Deepti Sharma closes the face of her bat and defends it.
Length ball, around off. Deepti Sharma stays in her crease and defends it out.
Hannah Rowe to continue...
Tad shorter, around off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to cover-point off the back foot.
Tosses it up, full in length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to covers.
Slower through the air, outside off, full in length. Smriti Mandhana leans and blocks it out.
Full again, outside off. Deepti Sharma gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 50 up!
Full toss, outside off. Smriti Mandhana knocks it down to long off for a single.
Loopy ball, full and outside off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it back to the bowler.
Short one again, around middle, Smriti Mandhana pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. She retains the strike!
Smriti Mandhana gives a quick concussion test. She is smiling and appears to be fine.
Bang on the helmet! Hannah Rowe drops it short now, around middle. Smriti Mandhana looks to pull but she misses. The ball hits the helmet and goes towards slip.
Hint of away movement now, full, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards cover.
Good-length delivery, around middle, Deepti Sharma nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Hannah Rowe pitches it up again, outside off. Deepti Sharma drives but finds the fielder at mid off.
Fuller ball, angling it in on middle. Deepti Sharma closes the face of her bat and pushes it towards mid on.
Quicker, outside off. Smriti Mandhana stays in the crease and pushes it to the fielder at cover. 2 runs off Frances Mackay's first over!
Slower through the air, fuller again outside off. Smriti Mandhana leans and defends it out.
Tosses it up, full and on middle, Smriti Mandhana pushes it back to the bowler.
Tad shorter, around middle. Deepti Sharma tucks it towards square leg and rotates the strike!
Loopy ball now, full, outside off. Deepti Sharma leans and blocks it out.
Frances Mackay begins with a shorter ball, turning away, outside off. Smriti Mandhana cuts it past point for a single.
Time for some spin! Frances Mackay is introduced into the attack.
Another short ball and this time Smriti Mandhana pulls it behind square leg for a single.
Short in length on middle, Sharma pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Angling it in, around middle, a tad fuller. Deepti Sharma works it towards mid-wicket. No run there!
FOUR LEG BYES! Tad fuller, down the leg side. Deepti Sharma looks to flick but misses. The ball deflects off her pads and rolls towards fine leg for a boundary.
Back of a length, around middle. Smriti Mandhana pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

TWO LEG BYES! On a length, shaping back in, on the pads. Smriti Mandhana misses her flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards fine leg and the batters complete two runs. There was a throw at the striker's end, but that misses the stumps.
Wide! Another one down the leg side, a tad shorter. Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls, but misses once again. Another wide called!
Wide! Spraying it down the leg side, on a length. Smriti Mandhana looks to flick but misses. Wide called!

Shout for an lbw! Not given. Hayley Jensen delivers an inswinger, just outside off and curling back in a shade, Deepti Sharma offers no shot and wears it on her front pad. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. It has not come back in enough.
Angling in on middle and leg, Deepti Sharma clips it on the leg side but finds mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off, Sharma mistimes her shot from the back foot to the off side.
On middle, helped to mid-wicket.
FOUR! That's the way to play it! Short in length and outside off, Deepti Sharma is on the back foot as she steers it through point for a boundary.

OUT! CAUGHT AT POINT! Shafali Verma continues to be loose with her stroke play on this tour and departs for another low score. Short in length, wide outside off, there to be hit, Verma camps back and slaps it square of the wicket on the off side. It's uppish and dying in front of the point fielder. Lauren Down is stationed there and she goes down low to snap it inches above the surface. It seems that she has done some damage to her elbows and is walking off the field with the physio.
Commentary.Howout: c Lauren Down b Hayley Jensen

Commentary.Commentary: Deepti Sharma comes out to bat at number 3.
FIVE WIDES! Sliding down the leg side, Verma tries to flick but misses. It goes closely past the pads and flies behind the keeper for a boundary.

FOUR! Fortunate for Smriti Mandhana! This one is dished out on a driving length outside off, Mandhana is lured into it but it takes the inner edge, beats the stumps and scoots past the keeper for a boundary at fine leg.
Just ahead of a good length outside off, Smriti Mandhana shows no footwork as she tries to force it through the line. Only manages to inside edge it back towards the bowler.
Short and wide outside off, Smriti Mandhana reaches out and slaps it to deep cover for a couple of runs again.
Fuller and on middle, Smriti wrists it through square leg for a brace.
On a length and around middle, defended back to the bowler.
A muted appeal for an lbw! Rowe delivers it on a length around off, getting it to shape in, Smriti Mandhana stays back to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! That's the Verma we know! Fuller and around leg, a hint of away movement, Shafali clears her front leg and lofts it behind mid on. It goes on a couple of bounces to the fence.
Full and around off, pushed to covers.
Hayley Jensen tries to bowl the magic delivery, attempts an outswinger from middle and leg, Shafali eases it through square leg for a couple of runs.

Nearly chops it on! Hayley Jensen delivers this from wide of the crease, on a length and outside off, shaping away, Shafali rocks back to cut but gets an under-edge. It drops beside the stumps and rolls behind.
Lands it full again, close to off, Verma drives but finds the cover fielder.
Loose from Shafali. Full and outside off, shaping away, Verma has a lazy waft at it and gets beaten.
Extra bounce this time, holding up a bit off the surface as well, Mandhana is on the back foot and checks her shot at the last moment.
Fullish and outside off, Smriti Mandhana drives with good timing but finds the cover fielder.
Back of a length around off, Shafali is on the back foot as she guides it wide of backward point for a single.
Straighter in line, Smriti Mandhana works it towards mid-wicket and scampers across to the other end.
Good length around leg, Smriti defends it from the back foot to the on side.
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side, Mandhana tries to flick but misses.
There is some movement out there at the moment! Fullish and close to off, moving away late, Verma tries to flick but gets a leading edge. The ball rolls through cover-point and they cross.
Hannah Rowe will bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Drifting down the leg side, on a length, Smriti Mandhana picks it off her pads and deflects it fine down the leg side for a boundary. Mandhana is away!
Serves it on a length around middle, Smriti defends it watchfully on this occasion.

Peach of a delivery! Cutting Smriti Mandhana in half. Hayley Jensen cooks a lovely inswinger this time, around off and on a length, Mandhana tries to defend but it nips back in to beat the inside edge.
Around leg, on a good length, Smriti defends it down on the leg side.

India Women are away! This one is delivered on a length outside off, Shafali Verma stays back and strokes it square of the wicket on the off side. The point fielder stops it partially and they cross for a single.
Wide! Hayley Jensen delivers another outswinger but the line is quite wide outside off, Verma has nothing to do with it.
Some late swing! Hayley Jensen delivers it on a length and outside off, Shafali Verma allows it through to the keeper.
